name: Ezekiel
overview: The book of Ezekiel opens during the captivity of King Jehoiachin, where Ezekiel receives divine visions by the river Chebar, marking the beginning of his prophetic ministry (Ezekiel 1:1-3). God’s glory is revealed to him through vivid imagery such as a great cloud with fire and brightness (Ezekiel 1:4), and he is commissioned as a messenger to the house of Israel, called to stand firm and deliver God's words faithfully (Ezekiel 2:1; 3:4). These passages emphasize Ezekiel’s role as a priest-prophet uniquely empowered by God to confront the people with His message during a time of judgment and exile.
